subject: Case study: Veridian Health — scheduling discovery interview & recording consent
messages:
From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.ai>
To: Priya Shah <priya.shah@veridianhealth.com>
Date: 2026-11-05T15:12:00-08:00
Subject: Case study: Veridian Health — scheduling discovery interview & recording consent

Hi Priya,

Thanks again for agreeing to help us put together a short case study on how Veridian is using Redwood Inference. We'd like to schedule a 45-minute discovery interview to capture:

- Key goals and measurable outcomes you saw after rollout
- High-level technical architecture used (non-sensitive) and integration points
- Customer impact stories / user workflows
- Any quantitative results you can share (latency, cost improvement, throughput)

Proposed agenda draft attached. Can you confirm who from your team should join (product, engineering, and legal are common)? Also: will Veridian be comfortable with a short recording for internal note-taking and later for a draft transcript that you can review before publication? We can redact PII and sensitive excerpts per your policy.

Availability: we can do any of the following windows (PST):
- Tue Nov 10, 10:00–11:00 or 14:00–15:00
- Wed Nov 11, 09:00–12:00
- Thu Nov 12, 11:00–13:00

If none of those work, send over 2–3 slots and we’ll match.

Attachments: case_study_agenda_v2.docx (draft).

Thanks — looking forward to it.

Best,
Hannah Schmitt
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
hannah.schmitt@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0198

Redwood Inference — Production-first LLM inference
From: Priya Shah <priya.shah@veridianhealth.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.ai>
Cc: Carlos Mendez <c.mendez@veridianhealth.com>, Veridian Legal <legal@veridianhealth.com>
Date: 2026-11-06T09:04:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Case study: Veridian Health — scheduling discovery interview & recording consent

Hi Hannah,

Thanks — happy to participate. Suggested internal attendees:
- Priya Shah (Product, myself)
- Carlos Mendez (Engineering lead)
- Legal (copied) will need to review any consent/permissions before publication

We prefer a 30–45 minute slot. Our availability (PST):
- Tue Nov 10, 14:00–14:45
- Wed Nov 11, 09:30–10:00 or 11:00–11:45

About recording: Legal typically asks for a written consent form and a chance to review any customer-facing copy. If you can share the consent form and confirm publication review, we can proceed. Also please flag any model-level or data-sensitive questions — we will request redaction for PHI or internal metrics tied to patient IDs.

I attached our branding guidelines and the person who will own approvals (Erica in Legal) is copied here as legal@veridianhealth.com.

Regards,
Priya Shah
Senior Product Manager, Veridian Health
priya.shah@veridianhealth.com | +1 212-555-4621

Hi Priya + team,

Thanks for the quick reply and for looping in Legal. Copying Ben (Customer Success) and Jonas (Sales lead) to coordinate the interview and logistics.

Quick answers:
- We can shorten to 30 minutes if preferred; will plan for 30 with a best-effort to cover the agenda.
- I'll attach our standard consent form (redwood_consent_form_v1.pdf) — Legal can review and request edits. We also support a DocuSign flow if that's easier (link below).
- We will not capture or publish any PHI; any sensitive metrics you flag will be redacted and only included after your review.

Proposed confirmed slot: Tue Nov 10, 14:00–14:30 PST (per your availability). Please confirm and we'll send a calendar invite.

Calendar/Docs: https://calendly.com/redwood/hannah-veridian-case-study (you can pick the confirmed time)
DocuSign (consent): https://app.docusign.com/envelope/EXAMPLE-ID-12345

Hannah —

Carlos will attend from Eng. For the agenda please deprioritize implementation-level logs or anything tying metrics to patient IDs; high-level numbers and percentage improvements are fine.

I attached the branding doc again for reference. Looking forward to the chat.

Best,
